paper.title: RIT-PDFMal-2026: A Comprehensive Benchmark Dataset for PDF Malware Detection
paper.reference_scope: Author manuscript/table transcription; DOI identifies the IEEE Access paper.

schema.paper: Paper describes 42 features including a per-PDF SHA-256 hash, which it says to remove before ML; Label is binary 0/1.
schema.local: 41 predictive columns plus Label; no hash column.

pdf_hash_and_feature_vector_distinction.paper_pdf_hash: The paper's hash field is the SHA-256 of a PDF file, retained to identify repetitions of the same file under different names and removed before ML.
pdf_hash_and_feature_vector_distinction.local_csv: No paper-style per-PDF hash column is present, so raw PDF identity or duplicate-PDF status cannot be verified locally.

local_feature_vector_findings.terminology: These are identical 41-dimensional static feature vectors in this CSV. They are not asserted to be duplicate PDF files because this local CSV has no per-PDF SHA-256 hash column.

feature_dictionary.paper_meaning: Size of the PDF file in kilobytes.
feature_dictionary.higher_lower_semantic_meaning: Paper SHAP discussion: lower size pushed toward malicious; larger size toward benign.

feature_dictionary.paper_meaning: Size of metadata extracted from the PDF file, in bytes.
Number of pages in the PDF file.
feature_dictionary.special_values: 0 is documented as occurring in deliberately corrupted malicious PDFs.
feature_dictionary.higher_lower_semantic_meaning: Paper SHAP discussion says a similar lower-versus-higher pattern to pdfsize applies.

feature_dictionary.paper_meaning: xref length as extracted from the file header.
Number of characters in the file title.
1 if the file is encrypted; 0 otherwise.
Number of embedded files inside the PDF, as extracted from the header.
Number of images in the PDF file.
feature_dictionary.special_values: -1 means the file is corrupted and the number of images cannot be shown.

feature_dictionary.paper_meaning: Whether the file contains at least the default threshold of 50 text characters.
feature_dictionary.special_values: 1: threshold met; 0: threshold not met; -1: corrupted file and text could not be read.
feature_dictionary.higher_lower_semantic_meaning: Paper SHAP discussion: 0 pushed toward malicious; >=50 characters (1) pushed toward benign.

feature_dictionary.paper_meaning: PDF version extracted from the file header.
feature_dictionary.special_values: The paper documents max 5 although the highest valid PDF version is 2.0; it attributes such invalid values to many malicious samples. Meaning of 0 is not explained.

contains_text.paper_interpretation: -1 is an intentional PDFMalExtract signal: corrupted file and text could not be read; 0/1 represent failure/success of the default 50-character threshold.
contains_text.alignment: Local -1 values are retained as documented signals; they are not treated as missing data.

images.paper_interpretation: -1 is an intentional PDFMalExtract signal: corrupted file and the image count could not be shown.
images.alignment: No local images=-1 observations were found; no values are changed.

pages.paper_interpretation: 0 pages is documented in deliberately corrupted malicious PDFs.
pages.alignment: Local zero-page observations are retained as documented signals; they are not treated as missing data.

pdf_ver.paper_interpretation: The paper states that values up to 5 occur, 2.0 is the highest valid PDF version, and many malicious samples use invalid version values. It does not explain the meaning of value 0.
pdf_ver.alignment: Values above 2 are retained as documented potentially malicious invalid-version signals. Value 0 remains unverified rather than cleaned or imputed.

descriptive_statistics_comparison.paper_note: Table 3 publishes mean, variance, minimum, and maximum. Standard deviation is derived here as sqrt(published variance); its status is judged against the published variance rounded to two decimals.

Acroform.paper_statement: The paper says this feature is consistently 0 across both classes and can be safely removed before training.
Acroform.author_treatment: Safe to remove prior to training; the paper does not explicitly state whether Table 5 retained or removed it in every fitted pipeline.

paper_experimental_protocol.train_test_split: Random 75% train / 25% test split with stratification.
paper_experimental_protocol.randomization_details: Random split is stated; random seed is not specified.
paper_experimental_protocol.cross_validation: Best classifier (XGB) underwent random 10-fold cross-validation; stratification for cross-validation is not specified.
paper_experimental_protocol.additional_analysis: ROC-AUC is shown graphically; SHAP is calculated for the best-performing model.
paper_experimental_protocol.feature_preprocessing: Features were extracted in numeric format to minimize preprocessing. The per-PDF hash should be removed before ML. Scaling, imputation, encoding, and normalization details are not specified.
paper_experimental_protocol.feature_removal: Acroform, Colors, and BaseEncoding are stated to be safe to remove before training because they have zero variance. Whether they were removed from every reported fit is not explicitly specified.

paper_shap_reference.instruction: Reference only for future sanity checks. Do not select features using these test-set-derived importances.

protocols.P_paper_reproduction: Reproduce the paper as closely as documentation permits: 75/25 random stratified train/test split, five published classical models, the reported metrics, and random 10-fold XGB cross-validation. Undocumented seed, hyperparameters, scaling, and exact zero-variance removal status remain not specified.
protocols.G_feature_disjoint_generalization: Use the existing deterministic seed-42 duplicate-feature-group-aware 60/20/20 train/validation/test manifest. Identical 41-dimensional feature representations cannot cross partitions.
protocols.comparison: Protocol G is stricter and has a validation partition; it is not directly equivalent to the paper's reported random 75/25 evaluation and must not be compared numerically as a direct reproduction.

terminology_corrections: Call the local CSV checksum a dataset-file SHA-256, not a PDF-file hash.
Call equal rows after excluding Label identical static feature vectors or duplicate feature groups, not duplicate PDF files.
The project's duplicate_group_id is a hash of static feature values, not the paper's SHA-256 hash of PDF bytes.
risks_before_training: The local CSV lacks per-PDF hashes, so raw-file identity and duplicate-PDF claims cannot be checked.
Protocol P cannot be exactly replicated until the paper's random seed, hyperparameters, and preprocessing details are available.
Protocol G contains a very large static-feature duplicate group; group-aware splitting is necessary and results are not directly comparable to the paper protocol.
Special corruption signals (-1 and zero-page cases) are documented values, not missing values; changing them would break paper alignment.
scope: Read-only paper-alignment audit. No raw data modification, model training, feature selection, normalization, encoding, imputation, or split change was performed.
